spellbook.finance/limitations: errorCode returned_package_reship_export_not_prepared means spellbook_returned_package_reship_prepare has not run for that case. Call it first.
errorCode returned_package_reship_tracking_conflict means the case is already resolved, with another tracking number or another resolution. Nothing was changed.
This is legacy tracking evidence, not explicit dispatch proof. The tracking number is not sent to a marketplace, and no buyer is told.
Postage paid for the new label is not recorded.
Workspace owner role is backend-enforced. This writes to the workspace you name and to no other.

description: Compatibility operation for reships completed outside the new Pull Sessions flow. Records tracking evidence supplied by the seller and resolves the case with resolution reship. It does not prove that an operator explicitly confirmed mailing, and it must not be called by new file-import or print flows. New reships use spellbook_returned_package_reship_dispatch with an explicit tracked or stamped/untracked mailing confirmation.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you choose for this batch. Required. Send the same key on a retry after a timeout.

matches.description: Up to 50 pairs of caseId and tracking number. Required, at least one.

caseId.description: The caseId of a prepared reship. Required.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number printed on the new label. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that shipped the orders, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required; writes only to this workspace.

name: spellbook_returned_package_reship_tracking
